# Welcome to the DIY Hydro Fieldwork cours pages [Under construction] {.unnumbered}

This site introduces hands-on hydrology experiments designed for field-based learning, developed by the <a href="https://www.geography.unibe.ch/research/hydrology/index_eng.html>Hydro Group </a> of [University of Bern] http://www.geography.unibe.ch/forschung/hydrologie. 

Developpers: 

Ueli Ammann, University of Bern, ueli.ammann  unibe.ch
Bettina Schaefli, University of Bern, bettina.schaefli unibe.ch
Natalie Ceperley, University of Bern, natalie ceperley unibe.ch

Use the navigation pane to explore each experiment.

[Please report any questions/bugs to](https://github.com/hydro-unibern/DIY-fieldwork/issues)

## Funding
The development of the course, the pilot and test phase is funded through the [Impuls Lehre] https://www.gutelehre.unibe.ch/foerderangebote/impuls__lehre programme (2026-2028) of University of Bern.
